title: Playboy Magazine July 1975 Lynn Schiller Francis Ford Coppola Interview
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, July 1975 issue, Playmate of the Month Lynn Schiller.
Featured: "Big Hit Man Talks!" — Playboy grills Godfather director Francis Ford Coppola. Also inside: "Looking at Legs," "Everything You Always Suspected About Airlines," "The Incredible Sex Doctor," Jimmy the Greek's gambling guide, and "Nudest Superstar."
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
